svg.title: The two-plaquette vacuum retains a joint orientation

cc:Work.dc:title: The two-plaquette vacuum retains a joint orientation
cc:Work.dc:description: Three-panel scientific explanation of the accepted fixed-graph SU(2) vacuum witness. C depicts the rigorous affine envelope 1/936 +/- 3r for J(r)/r^2 on 0<r<=1/3000, not simulated vacuum values. B depicts exact configuration geometry and second-order coefficients.
